kkConditionalRoutes.title: How does the conditional recoil model depend on the decay history?
kkConditionalRoutes.rationale: Compare a microscopic rate question with a conditional linear-cosmology calculation. Their targets differ; the latter does not establish that its assumed cascade occurs.

kkConditionalRoutes.title: Is the assumed repeated-decay history microscopically supported?
kkConditionalRoutes.rationale: The linear model presupposes repeated near-threshold decays. Check the applicable threshold rate without replacing the conditional calculation by a universal exclusion.

kkConditionalRoutes.title: Which initial KK population does the cosmology assume?
kkConditionalRoutes.rationale: The linear analysis inherits hot-brane production with an initially empty bulk and a specified initial temperature. This is an initial-condition route, not source equivalence.
